temporal_policy: 5 spatially overlapping samples spanning >=4 s, gap <=6 s; rearm after 30 s without a positive sample
limitations: Archive frames are minute-cadence camera imagery; no continuous false-alert rate is inferred from them.
Continuous FURG clips predate model training; their membership in upstream training data is unknown.
The fixed model predates all selected HPWREN holdout events; no tuning on holdout scores is permitted.
Smoke-only object detector; a smokeless flame may be missed. No operational acceptance is inferred.
